notes.title: Refuse an unknown branch
notes.text: Gives the branch in its stored form, and refuses a branch that lends no books.

notes.title: The pickup rules of a branch
notes.text: Holds the open days of a branch, and works out the last pickup day from them.

diagrams.title: The tables of holds

fileNotes.title: Build the request service
fileNotes.text: Gives each call a RequestService with the database and the mailer of this library.

fileNotes.title: Send the requests of a member
fileNotes.text: Returns the requests of one member as plain dicts for the purchase team.

fileNotes.title: Answer one book request
fileNotes.text: Takes the answer of a librarian and turns a refusal into an answer with a status.

fileNotes.title: Shape one request row
fileNotes.text: Builds the BookRequest that the member page and the desk show.

fileNotes.title: Read the requests of a member
fileNotes.text: Returns the requests of one member, the newest first.

fileNotes.title: Answer the request
fileNotes.text: Stores the answer of a librarian and tells each member who asked for the same book.

fileNotes.title: Lock the requests for the book
fileNotes.text: Locks the request and each open request for the same book, in one order.

fileNotes.title: Check the librarian
fileNotes.text: Refuses a librarian who is not in the purchase team.

fileNotes.title: Return an earlier answer
fileNotes.text: Returns the stored request when the same answer comes again with its key.

fileNotes.title: Refuse an unknown answer
fileNotes.text: Refuses an answer that is not in the list, and a request that another librarian answered first.

fileNotes.title: Write the answer into the rows
fileNotes.text: Writes the answer, the librarian and the key into each open request for the book.

fileNotes.title: Order the book
fileNotes.text: Adds a purchase order when the library buys or borrows the book.

fileNotes.title: Collect the members who asked
fileNotes.text: Reads the active members who asked for the same book.

fileNotes.title: Mail each member
fileNotes.text: Sends each member one mail with the answer of the librarian.

fileNotes.title: Give back the answered request
fileNotes.text: Reads the request again and returns it with its answer.

fileNotes.title: Ask for a book
fileNotes.text: Saves one open request of a member after its checks.

fileNotes.title: Clean the title and the ISBN
fileNotes.text: Takes the dashes out of the ISBN and refuses a request with no title.

fileNotes.title: Refuse a book of the library
fileNotes.text: Refuses a book that the library has, because a hold fits it better.

fileNotes.title: Limit the open requests
fileNotes.text: Refuses a new request while the member has five open requests.

fileNotes.title: Refuse the same request twice
fileNotes.text: Refuses a second open request of the member for the same title.

fileNotes.title: Insert the request row
fileNotes.text: Inserts the open request with its time and where it came from.

fileNotes.title: Give back the new request
fileNotes.text: Returns the new request as the member page shows it.

fileNotes.title: Send the answer to a member
fileNotes.text: Writes the mail for a bought, borrowed or declined book and sends it.

processes.title: Answer a book request
processes.summary: Stores the answer of a librarian and tells each member who asked for the book.

processes.title: List the requests of a member
processes.summary: Returns the book requests of one member, the newest first.

processes.title: Ask the library for a book
processes.summary: Checks the book and the member, then saves one open request for the purchase team.
